# Fenwright

> Consulting and systems that give small service businesses their time back.

Fenwright works with clinics, salons and trades in Ireland and the UK. We find where the week
leaks time and money, then build the systems that plug it: enquiries answered, bookings kept,
admin handled.

- [Homepage](https://fenwright.ie/): overview, services, live demo and how we work
- [About](https://fenwright.ie/#about): who runs Fenwright
- [Privacy](https://fenwright.ie/privacy): privacy policy and data handling

Contact: contact@fenwright.ie
